title: Stretching Exercises on Symptoms of Primary Dysmenorrhea
brief_summary: The purpose of this study was to assess the effect of active stretching exercises on reducing pain and the quality of life during menstrual cycle in young adult females.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BMI of 20-29.9 kg/m2,
* regular menstrual cycle
* length 28-30 day
* cycle bleed from 3 to 7 days,

Exclusion Criteria:

* contraindication to stretching exercise
* taking any hormonal medications:
* smoker
